name: ours-vite-react-router
description: This repository provides an example of integrating Ours analytics with a Vite + React Router application. It demonstrates how to set up the Ours pixel script, track page views on route changes, and log custom events, all while maintaining HIPAA-compliant analytics for privacy-focused applications.

paragraphs: This repo is a working reference for integrating the Ours Privacy CDP (Customer Data Platform) and CMP (Consent Management Platform) into a client-side React application using Vite and React Router. Browse the code to see how each product is installed, initialized, and used.
In a client-side React SPA, index.html is the single entry point for every route. It is the right place to load analytics and consent scripts because:
features: It runs once — the HTML loads when the visitor first arrives. Scripts initialize once and persist across client-side route navigations.
It covers every page — every route the React Router renders inherits whatever is in index.html, with no extra configuration.
Load order is deterministic — scripts in execute in document order, so placing the CMP before the CDP guarantees consent is available before tracking starts.
